Schedule a coverage review

Booking opens Luay’s page on PlanEnroll. Create your profile there and ask for your meeting. Having these ready makes the first conversation useful:

  • Your ZIP code and who needs coverage.
  • Your Medicare card, if you have Medicare.
  • The doctors and prescriptions you want covered.
  • The coverage you have today, if any.

When PlanEnroll asks what type of meeting you would like, choose Health for Medicare or health insurance, Life for life insurance, or Annuities for retirement income. For a Health meeting you may be asked to complete a short Scope of Appointment form first. It does not obligate you to enroll. The first open time is at least 24 hours ahead. To talk sooner, call (301) 615-8289 or text (571) 354-0146.

Common questions

Where we help

Which states do you serve?
We are licensed in Virginia, Maryland, West Virginia, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Texas, Louisiana, Alabama, Michigan, Indiana, Delaware, the District of Columbia, Kentucky, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, and Florida, and we help clients by phone or video call.
Do I need to live near your office?
No. Our office is in Tysons, Virginia, but we help people in all 16 states and DC by phone or video, and our help is free to you.
What if my state is not on the list?
We cannot help with plans in states where we are not licensed. Call (301) 615-8289 if you are moving to one of our states or have a family member there.
